_commentaire: Manifeste du module anglais lakour-veillees-en (engendré par outils/fabriquer-veillees.mjs --langue en) : ce qui change par rapport à modules/lakour-veillees/module.json. Le reste (version, auteurs, adresses, compatibilité, système, scripts, langues, packs et leurs droits) est repris du manifeste français. « niveaux » : libellés des niveaux des compositions (assets/compositions.json), « media » : légendes.
title: La Kour — The Vigils of Brumecombe
description: Content for the original game “The Vigils of Brumecombe” (Les Veillées de Brumecombe), a social deduction game of the werewolf family for the lakour-loups system, in English: 35 original roles (the Pack, the Village, the loners, the travellers), 14 public trades, 10 buildings that each change a rule, the map of the village of Brumecombe with its 18 houses and its placement plan, the tokens, the player's and narrator's guides, the variants (Almanac of Mists, the Dock, Mourning Bell, Saint Martin's Night, Small table), four illustrated holiday vigils, the narrator's tables and 48 ready-made setups for 4 to 18 players. Original texts and map; token silhouettes: icons from game-icons.net (CC BY 3.0), see CREDITS.md. — English edition of the French module lakour-veillees: same documents, same identifiers; do not enable both at once. Any text not yet translated appears in French.
